new_results.statement: For X independent of a pair (C,D), scalar cap F, pair joint-density cap M, and Q=2 beta X C+alpha C^2+2 delta CD+gamma D^2+affine with beta gamma nonzero, ||p_Q||_infinity <=3(2MF)^(2/3)|beta^2 gamma|^(-1/3).

For exact rank-three A=RMR^T with a null physical pivot of leverage q and transverse Pluecker maximum omega_*, ||p||_(infinity,ess)<=3*2^(2/3)(|det M|q omega_*)^(-1/3)<=3*2^(2/3)(q omega_*)^(-1/3)/s. Hence any blow-up sequence must be high-dimensional and transverse-Pluecker diffuse.

If in the same exact-rank-three null-pivot chamber the physical hub has leverage exactly one, Parseval forces the residual active pair to be a 2D orthogonal projection of the residual product source, independent of the hub. Using the pinned pair-density cap <=2 gives ||p||_(infinity,ess)<=3*2^(4/3)|det M|^(-1/3)<=7.559526299369239/s, with no leaf-leverage, finite-support, or individual-Pluecker condition.

rank_two_log_control: At the rank-two endpoint gamma=0, centered unit uniforms with C=(X1-X2)/sqrt(2) give R=2 beta X0 C and p_R(t)>=[1/(sqrt(2)|beta|)] log(|beta|/(2sqrt(2)|t|)) for small nonzero t. Restoring the third Schur curvature gamma D^2 removes the logarithm through a u^(-3/2) layer-cake estimate while retaining the dependent pair (C,D); no post-rotation independence is asserted.
sign_specific_geometry: After transverse alignment the active matrix is [[0,beta,0],[beta,alpha,delta],[0,delta,gamma]]. The leading block is hyperbolic and its Schur complement in the third direction is exactly gamma; gamma>0 gives signature (2,1), gamma<0 gives (1,2), while delta only shears the sheets.
